not_determined.openml_climate: not in the accepted 22 Oct E1 run (no joint seeds for this node)

parameters.mc_error: sqrt(p (1 - p) / subsets) for Monte Carlo cells, 0 for exhaustive cells; a Monte Carlo cell with p = 0 or 1 has a 95 % bound of 3 / subsets (rule of three)

readings.Rt: direction * mean_K / (sd_K / sqrt(K)) > t_{0.95, K-1}; sd_K = 0: direction * mean_K > 0
readings.direction: sign of the 30-seed mean paired difference, 0 counted as +
